academySales.inviteTitle: Invite an academy to sell presale
academySales.inviteDesc: The academy sells with its link and gets a percentage of the list price. You pay their commission outside the app; the record of what you owe them lives here.
academySales.empty: No academies selling this presale yet.
academySales.commissionPctHint: Percentage of the list price per ticket (1 to 90).
academySales.maxTicketsHint: Optional — attribution turns off when the cap is reached.
academySales.markPaidDesc: You paid {amount} to {academy} outside the app. Mark the payment to keep the record.
academySales.markCollectDesc: {academy} paid you {amount} outside the app for presales it charged with codes. Mark the collection to keep the record.
academySales.codesDesc: Issue a code for each sale you charge directly. The person enters it when buying and their ticket gets released.
academySales.codesEmpty: No codes issued for this agreement yet.
academySales.disableConfirmDesc: {academy's} link will stop attributing new sales. Sales already paid and pending debt are untouched.
academySales.academyEmpty: No producer has invited you to sell presale yet.
academySales.academyEmptyHint: When a producer invites you, the agreement appears here to accept it and get your sale link.
academySales.seriesLinkHint: Works for all the series' events: use any event's link and add your ?a= parameter.
academySales.invitedDesc: The producer invited you to sell presale for this event. If you accept, you get your attribution link.
